mentions.name: Scryspell
mentions.description: This app records user sessions and provides web analytics, letting developers replay exactly what their users saw — including browser console logs and network traffic — to fix UI and UX issues. It ships preset analytics charts (top entry page, top exit page, etc.) and is adding support for user-defined trend and funnel charts, with a goal of simple analytics plus session recording with masking.
mentions.problem: Developers struggle to fix UI and UX issues without seeing exactly what their users experienced.
mentions.audience: Helps developers fix UI and UX issues by letting them see exactly what their users saw.
mentions.source_excerpt:

mentions.name: Scryspell
mentions.description: A simple session recording and analytics tool for websites, with session recording as the core feature (built on the rrweb library and the Mutation Observer API), plus standard analytics. Built as a lightweight alternative to tools like Squeaky (which shut down) and PostHog (whose large UI the author found overwhelming), with a React/TypeScript/TanStack Query frontend and Java/Spring Boot/PostgreSQL backend.
mentions.problem: Existing session recording options fell short: Squeaky shut down, and PostHog's huge UI is overwhelming for users who just want simple session recording and analytics.
